title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: FlowFields
summary: This series covers FlowFields, a powerful feature in Business Central that calculates values (sum, average, count, min, max, exist, lookup) from related tables. Articles discuss how FlowFields work, extending them, using FlowFilters, handling permissions, managing drill-downs, and new features in BC26 like selective calculation and the SetAutoCalcFields method.
key_points: FlowFields perform calculations (sum, average, count, min, max, exist, lookup) on related table data without storing values
FlowFilters allow filtering FlowField totals on lists, with support for default filter settings
Users lacking read permissions on source tables see blank FlowField values
BC26 introduces selective FlowField calculation for visible fields and SetAutoCalcFields method on RecordRef
FlowFields cannot be nested (based on other FlowFields) in queries

quotes.text: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 release wave 1 (BC26) is available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals new FlowField enhancements in the latest release for performance optimization
